acceptanceCriteria: A 47k-entry walk completes in a measured few seconds on the same host class, with the profile retained.
Walk results are byte-identical to the current walk.
GitHub #1063 is closed with the measurement.
body: Residual from V1-1626 (PR #1089, GitHub #1063 stays open for this). Measured in the gh-acquire lane: a 47k-entry store's journal walk takes 29-56 s where 2-4 s is expected; 17.4 s of a 31.5 s walk is openat under nativeRead.Read, 185 us/file at 94k files vs 18 us isolated (profile walk1.prof, kept in /private/tmp/cem10-build/gh-acquire-scratch). Expected: the faster/incremental prefix walk #1063 asked for, so acquire on a large moving journal settles in seconds.

completion.reason: Delivered on main ef2a01db52d5436c262725d136060c9eb95e8580 via batch beamfall/corvint#1464 (lane #1454); CI green on that commit (runs 39675360530,39677108995). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 cc14e77a76a116b6e9d750ef5d88f7a478484ac15a614fe3d19abc5d64769b31.

title: journal walk: openat costs 185 us/file at 94k files (vs 18 us isolated); the faster prefix walk from #1063 is undelivered
